description: PHOTO TO 3D: one photo of an object becomes a textured 3D model (.glb, PBR) plus a 5 s turntable video and a still of it. quality 'detailed' = finer geometry and textures at twice the price. Takes about two minutes. Paid; dryRun returns the price.

dryRun.description: price only: nothing made, nothing charged

expected_credits.description: the get_cost price; refused unbilled if the live price differs

get_cost.description: true: return the price only; nothing runs or bills

idempotency_key.description: chosen once, resent unchanged on retries: the same key never buys twice

image.description: the picture: an https / upload_file URL, a Library id (L0…), or a local path on the CLI; one object, at least 128 px a side

name: photo_to_model
title: Photo to 3D model
